modules.name: Recovery profile topology
modules.responsibility: Render public provider groups and ordered fallback paths, including empty-group behavior and a selected bootstrap proxy before HTTP providers initialize.
modules.interface: Produce a deterministic client profile that keeps an inline SEED provider for runtime selection, exposes bootstrap SEED nodes independently of HTTP provider load order, prefers healthy LIVE, and keeps PRIVATE to SEED to DIRECT fetch order after startup.
modules.seam: Parsed top-level bootstrap proxy references and actual Mihomo startup and group-selection behavior.

modules.name: Provider seed and cache lifecycle
modules.responsibility: Provide validated bootstrap nodes and retain the last usable LIVE cache when an update fails.
modules.interface: Supply the immutable SEED snapshot and apply successful LIVE updates while preserving existing data on failure.
modules.seam: Seed snapshot construction and provider refresh error handling.

interfaces.name: Public profile rendering
interfaces.idempotency: Rendering the same inputs produces the same profile topology and group names.

interfaces.name: Provider update lifecycle
operations: retain cached LIVE provider after failure
interfaces.idempotency: A repeated failed refresh leaves the previously stored LIVE provider unchanged.

transitions.action: Reject an empty LIVE selection and use the next usable provider group.

transitions.event: LIVE becomes empty or unhealthy without SEED
transitions.action: Do not report a false LIVE route.

transitions.guard: At least one LIVE node passes the configured health check.

transitions.event: Provider fetch requires the final fallback
transitions.guard: PRIVATE and SEED are unavailable for the provider request.
transitions.action: Attempt the configured direct provider fetch.

transitions.guard: A valid LIVE cache exists before the update.
transitions.action: Keep the old provider content available.

transitions.guard: The new provider response validates successfully.
transitions.action: Replace the old provider content with the validated response.

failure_handling.failure: PRIVATE or LIVE has no nodes.
failure_handling.response: Set its empty fallback to REJECT so the containing fallback can continue to the next declared group.
Leave the previous cache intact and report the update failure through existing service behavior.

failure_handling.failure: Published edge or client traffic cannot be verified.
failure_handling.response: Report the exact incomplete evidence and do not claim successful production recovery.
